data.name: Munabbih
data.gender_notes: Munabbih is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Munabbih is the one who narrates or recites the Quran or Hadith. It is a name that highlights the importance of sharing knowledge and spreading the message of Islam. The name Munabbih carries the meaning “To narrate or recite” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munabbih usually hope their child will grow to embody to narrate or recite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To spread the word of God and guide others
data.etymology: Munabbih belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “To narrate or recite.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munabbih total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
